name: Interval Learning
format: 1-on-1 live, one dedicated teacher per student
timings: Batch windows: Mon-Fri 6-8 AM and 2-4 PM; weekends 8 AM-12 PM and 2-6 PM; evenings 5-7 PM and 7-9 PM
timings_note: Batch windows, not fixed class times. Sessions per week and session length are not stated. The FAQ recommends 2-3 classes per subject per week.
